supervisor_changes: Assert exact done42, lost0/0, bad0, rejected0 and drained queues after40COPY.
Remove unused MUT_ADVANCE flag/bypasses and unused Python duplicate of executable bench mutants.
limits: No physical clock/CDC/metastability/SDF/card qualification; Verilator2state and DFFRE functional shim.
Source banked shadows check registered data at real memory boundaries; no full mapped netlist substitution in this bench.
Forty COPY packets are identical; order among wholly identical packets cannot be discriminated. Word transport, counts and field equality are checked.
The pressure-mode mutation is detected at first COPY before FIFO saturation; it is not a mutation of AHB hold during an already-full state.
ahb_stall11 counts only the initial DDR-held gate window, not total AHB stalls; qfull551/cmdfull2232 are sampled clock-cycle counts, not distinct transitions.
Dedicated sentinel runner invocation repeats positive+sentinel already exercised at each clockratio.
